item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continue to hit Ukrainian targets, with a drone strike on a Ukrainian aid centre raising the death toll to 53, according to Reuters, while Ukraine responded with drone attacks on the Ryazan refinery and sites in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts, injuring four people. Russia also suffered a drone strike that set an Ozon warehouse ablaze in southern Russia. Germany announced an additional €100 million for Ukrainian infrastructure and Italy prepared fresh military aid despite coalition splits. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens, and the IDF arrested three Palestinians planning terror attacks in the West Bank. In Gaza, gunfire damaged tents at the Rafah displacement site as aid teams prepared for winter storms, and residents built wind turbines from rubble and turned discarded cooking pots into seawalls. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Iran launched a missile that struck a building in Tel Aviv and threatened to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if U.S. conditions are met, while the United States struck Iran's Qeshm Island. Iran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas pipeline deal and a rocket launcher deal deepens Russia-Iran ties. South Korea is extending anti-piracy patrols closer to the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran reports tankers hit in the strait and a Saudi coalition intercepting a missile aimed at Medina. Iran has sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar and is reviewing concrete proposals on its nuclear program. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The coalition downed a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Medina and intercepted another long-range anti-tank guided missile that struck a Saudi-backed vehicle, wounding a fighter. A market strike in southwestern Yemen killed at least 20 civilians, and a missile attack on an oil tanker in the Gulf killed a sailor. item.description:

item.title: Nigeria: the situation
item.description:
Gunmen in Kaduna killed two people and kidnapped 18, while bandits abducted dozens in multiple raids, and suspected armed herders shot a 14‑year-old girl in Nasarawa. In Benue, four people died and 14 were critically ill after a suspected herbal poisoning, and Southern Kaduna killings led HURIWA to ask the DSS to probe possible political sponsorship. The army rescued 16 abducted individuals in Niger State, troops destroyed terrorist enclaves in Borno and forced insurgents to retreat, and youths at Igbudu market attacked NAFDAC officials in Delta.
